title: Like Before but Blue
tests: Uses the prior poster as the edit reference and changes only its background colour, preserving text, layout and artwork.

faults.what: Both text lines extend beyond the left and right edges, cutting off essential letters and the ending time.
The poster is approximately 3:4 rather than the requested 4:5.
The crescent is muted blue-gray rather than cream and overlaps the headline.
A large lighter rectangular background region creates visible horizontal color boundaries rather than a consistent navy field.

judge.summary: The navy poster has severely cropped oversized text, a gray crescent, and the wrong aspect ratio, making it unusable.

must_haves.item: The final output is one 4:5 poster with a deep navy background instead of burnt orange.
must_haves.why: There is one navy poster, but its visible aspect ratio is approximately 3:4, not 4:5.
The headline is clipped at both sides, so the complete wording is not visible.

must_haves.item: The smaller line reads exactly 'SATURDAY 6–10 PM'.
must_haves.why: The day and time are clipped, the ending time is not visible, and PM appears on a separate line.

must_haves.item: The cream lettering and cream crescent moon retain their previous positions, sizes and appearance.
must_haves.why: No previous poster is supplied for comparison; the visible crescent is blue-gray rather than cream.

must_haves.item: No new words, decorative elements or layout changes are introduced.
must_haves.why: No original image is available to establish what changed; the output contains no readable extra words.
